provenance: Simulated: published LBNL; exploratory reused held-out outputs

physical_fault_events.status: Pending independently documented onset/offset and intervention annotations
physical_fault_events.reason: Fixed annual normal/fault scenarios are not a labeled fault-onset trajectory. Eligible-window boundaries are not fault onsets.

window_definition: Maximal consecutive eligible one-minute samples within same case; gaps and excluded rows break windows. Zero allowable gap.
latency_definition: Elapsed timestamp difference from window start to first confirmed alert; no fault-onset or early-warning claim. Window starts may be censored by test start or operating gate.
persistence_note: N consecutive one-minute samples at t0..t(N-1) span N-1 elapsed minutes. Threshold crossings, exclusions and cadence affect delay; dwell setting alone is not a measured detection delay.

normal.interpretation: Normal windows with alert are false-alarm opportunities; fault windows are observation opportunities, not fault-event recall.
